# Plan: stale-session-signals

Goal: No session should work from a stale picture, and today three kinds of staleness are silent. (1) A session whose commits land inside a peer's push learns it only on its own next prompt — commit-attribution D13 accepted an optional ping over that ref-gated read, a note named it task 3.5, the plan was rewritten twice without it, and the initiative closed over it. (2) A session keeps the sofar tool surface it started with: after a publish and upgrade it silently holds the old MCP tools, which cost this repo two wrong conclusions in one day (commit-attribution M5). (3) The close audit cannot see work a decision promised but no task implements — the exact gap that let D13 through — and it cannot be a mechanical check, because reading intent out of prose is the inference staleness-detection D3/D12 bans.

Progress: 5/5 tasks done (100%)
